$comment: The right workflow with a reason that would fit any intent at all. This is the case that says route accuracy
on its own is not enough: a router that happens to be right and cannot say why is indistinguishable, on the
menu code alone, from one that read the message.
A frozen copy of one case of the live corpus and of the menu it is scored against. The pair (expected, menu)
is the whole input to scoreCase beside the reply, so both are stored here rather than read live: a replay has
to keep scoring the scenario it was derived against after the corpus moves on, and
npm run test:eval-routing-data already holds the live corpus against the shipped menu.

expected.rationale: The implementation is shipped, so tests are written against it rather than ahead of it. This is the mirror of the ATDD case and the pair is what separates them.
